en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from his father, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted
[70:1] A questioner, asked for the Punishment to befall [70:2] For the unbelievers in the Wilayah of Aliasws, there is none to avert it’.
Then heasws said: ‘This is how, by Allahazwj Jibraeelas descended with it unto Muhammadsaww’.
en.sarwar: 47. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Sayf from his brother from his father from abu Hamza from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High.
“. . your ideas are confused [51:8]. Let whoever wishes, turn away from it (Wilaya, Leadership with Divine Authority) (Our Quran).” [51:9]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “whoever would turn away from Wilaya, (Leadership with Divine Authority) he has turned away from paradise.”
